# ataila_project_network (Data Source)

A project's network as the platform derives and applies it: the zone's subnets, the VLANs, the per-VM security groups with every rule and which VM sits in which, the bounded allows on the project's gateways, a Kubernetes project's network policies and a VPC-mode project's VPC (preview).

Read only: the network follows the project's settings. A change of `ataila_project`'s exposure, application gateway, UAT publishing or egress settings marks the network stages stale, and `ataila_project_provisioning` applies them; until then the applied parts read here show the network as it was.

Needs `networking-read-global`; a tenant-scoped token reads its own tenant's projects. Platform release 1.0.401 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ataila_project_network" "shop" {
  project_id = ataila_project.shop.id
}

# Every VM whose firewall the platform has not applied yet.
output "not_yet_protected" {
  value = [for vm in data.ataila_project_network.shop.vms : vm.name if !(vm.enabled && vm.applied)]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Id of the project.

### Read-Only

- `deployment_backend` (String) `vm` or `k8s`.
- `gateway_allows` (Attributes List) The bounded allows on the project's gateways, as applied, each once. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gateway_allows))
- `kubernetes` (Attributes) A Kubernetes project's network policies; null for a VM project. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kubernetes))
- `network_mode` (String) `vlan`, or `vpc` for a VPC-mode project (preview).
- `security_groups` (Attributes List) The per-VM security groups, as applied. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--security_groups))
- `subnets` (Attributes List) The zone's subnets (VM projects). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnets))
- `vlans` (Attributes List) The project's VLANs, as applied. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vlans))
- `vms` (Attributes List) Each VM's group and firewall state. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vms))
- `vpc` (Attributes) A VPC-mode project's VPC (preview); null otherwise. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpc))

<a id="nestedatt--gateway_allows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `gateway_allows`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) What the rule does.
- `chain` (String) `forward`, `input` or `output`.
- `comment` (String) What the rule is for.
- `destination` (String) Where it goes; null for anywhere.
- `ports` (String) The ports; null for any.
- `protocol` (String) The protocol; null for any.
- `source` (String) Where the traffic comes from; null for anywhere.


<a id="nestedatt--kubernetes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kubernetes`

Read-Only:

- `namespace` (String) The project's first namespace.
- `policies` (Attributes List) The policies, per namespace: deny by default, then the allows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--kubernetes--policies))

<a id="nestedatt--kubernetes--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `kubernetes.policies`

Read-Only:

- `detail` (String) What it allows or denies.
- `egress` (List of String) For an egress allow: the dependencies it lets the pods reach.
- `name` (String) The policy's name.
- `namespace` (String) The namespace it applies in.



<a id="nestedatt--security_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `security_groups`

Read-Only:

- `cluster` (String) The cluster it is applied on.
- `comment` (String) What the group is for.
- `environment` (String) The environment it serves.
- `name` (String) The group's name.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Its rules, in order (first match wins). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--security_groups--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--security_groups--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `security_groups.rules`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) `ACCEPT`, `DROP` or `REJECT`.
- `comment` (String) What the rule is for.
- `destination` (String) Where it goes; null for anywhere.
- `direction` (String) `in` or `out`.
- `port` (String) The destination port or range; null for any.
- `position` (Number) Its place in the group.
- `protocol` (String) The protocol; null for any.
- `source` (String) Where the traffic comes from; null for anywhere.

### Nested Schema for `subnets`

Read-Only:

- `cidr` (String) The subnet.
- `environments` (List of String) The environments in it.
- `site` (String) The site it is on.


<a id="nestedatt--vlans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vlans`

Read-Only:

- `cidr` (String) Its subnet.
- `gateway` (String) The project's gateway address on it.
- `name` (String) Its name.
- `site` (String) The site it is on.
- `vlan_id` (Number) The VLAN id.


<a id="nestedatt--vms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vms`

Read-Only:

- `environment` (String) Its environment.
- `group` (String) The security group it sits in.

### Nested Schema for `vpc`

Read-Only:

### Nested Schema for `vpc.vnets`

Read-Only:

- `cidr` (String) Its subnet.
- `environment` (String) The environment it serves.
- `gateway` (String) Its gateway address.
- `gateway_applied` (Boolean) True once its gateway is applied.
- `id` (String) The VNet's id.
